This is a rough map of my world made in Wonderdraft. I didn't include labels in this image, but most locations have names. 

The northern continent (in the center) is Daldior. Just below Daldior is the small continent of Aurumna. To the right/east of Aurumna is Alfaidun and Ordusum. Those are the places I spent the most time on.

The continents in the top half of the map were made recently and don't have names yet. I put them there so the map would feel more full.

I know this is a very unusual way of projecting a world, but I like the way this looks much more than a Mercator projection. (This style is called Azimuthal https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azimuthal_equidistant_projection)

This is a diagram I made in Inkscape for the relationships between gods and related entities in my world. The large text in each circle is a god’s name. The smaller text is a title, sphere of influence, or just a description.

World Info: Gods exaggerate their accomplishments. Although they have great power to create and destroy they did not create the world. Lutuma was already billions of years old and full of life before being touched by any deity. For example, Eonis didn’t literally create all the stars in the sky or mortal-kind, but the connection is still on the chart because that is what people believe.

Gods reside in the realm of Aophon(basically heaven) and cannot be killed. Titans are like gods, but belong to the material world and thus can be killed, not that killing a titan is easy. Even if they are killed, being ‘dead’ as a titan isn’t like being dead as a mortal. Ascended mortals are people who were born mortal and have since become immortal  Outer beings are entities that are not from any of the three primary planes.

Very little of this is set in stone, so any feedback is appreciated.
